structure.unit: Abandoned, Immobilized, Unattended and Trespassing Vehicles; Parking

law.catch_line: Regulation of vehicular and pedestrian traffic on certain parking lots
law.text: The governing body of any county, city, or town may by ordinance regulate the flow of vehicular and pedestrian traffic, the parking of vehicles, and speed limits on parking lots which are open to the public and designed to accommodate fifty or more vehicles, but no such ordinance shall conflict with state law.
